ac:layout-cell.p: Logical Feature Specification · API Reuse Assessment · Feature landing page

This stakeholder overview explains the onboarding outcome, scope and main decisions. SEI019 shows the high-level journeys; SEI021 assesses engineering reuse and Spain-specific changes. All are based on SPEC-SEI-002.

The predecessor, phase boundaries and ONB/OFR meanings remain unchanged. SPEC-SEI-018 is selected for the stable summary page after the authorised publication. Implementation approval and delivery-feature breakdown remain open.

Help a Spanish business set up, connect, confirm or extend supported e-invoicing functions through Sage. A direct customer or authorised accountant must understand what is ready, what is active and who must act next. An existing customer should complete only missing or invalidated work.

Audience: local Product teams, directors and cross-functional stakeholders. Use this page for the business outcome, scope, responsibilities and decisions. Read SEI019 for the main process paths and exceptions. Architects and engineers use SEI021 for existing capabilities, public/private Spain tailoring and evidence gaps.
Customer onboarding is the Master Feature journey. Behaviour remains proposed; a sourced fact or recorded decision does not prove implementation readiness.
Use the shared glossary. These distinctions are essential to the summary.

tr.td: The business whose setup or invoice function is affected. It is separate from the authenticated caller.
Current permission for a specific action for that business. A login, client relationship or certificate alone is insufficient.
An evidenced check result for a stated function, actor and environment, with limitations and recheck conditions.
An evidenced start of authorised use for the exact function, direction and scope. Connection and readiness are separate results.
Correct or establish the result of affected work, then return to its blocked check.

ac:layout-cell.p: An authorised customer or accountant requests setup for one business or independent client businesses. Return each function’s result, limitations and action owner. Existing setup needs only missing or invalidated work.

tr.td: Select a supported option and establish the required checks.
Establish Sage access for selected functions without assuming new public enrolment (SPFE-S03).
Keep the provider and connect its qualified account to Sage.
Qualify the function assigned to each service and return independent results.
Confirm unchanged valid setup or add only requested functions.
Change supported future work at an authorised boundary; preserve earlier obligations.
Assess B2B separately and retain the B2G setup.
Explain the limitation or missing evidence and give an owned next action. The unlisted-provider option remains TBD; a planned provider list does not establish availability.

ac:layout-cell.p: SEI019 identifies these situations as ONB-S01–08. Each can apply to a direct customer, an accountant for one client or a portfolio. A single client does not require batch processing.
Phase 1 returns public readiness. Private setup and activation need later-phase qualification. Private A to Private B remains gated.

Private-platform timing: customer ERP setup and operator interconnection are separate. For qualifying platform-to-platform requests, the receiving operator has one month, subject to the specific queue exception; the public solution provides the required interim exchange. This is not a general 30-day onboarding promise. SEI019 ONB-R25 defines the clock and handoff. REF-INTERCONNECT.

tr.td: Each function has a supported, evidenced result. Public readiness and later activation retain separate meanings.
The requested work has a recorded final disposition. Existing service remains subject to its own state and obligations.
Safe pending work is stopped and every possible external effect has sufficient evidence-backed resolution for closure.
Not an endpoint. Retain the owner and recovery path; do not infer completion from escalation.

ac:layout-cell.p: Invoice creation, sending, retrieval, reporting and full exit belong to their owning features. Onboarding supplies setup evidence and checks dependencies.

tr.td: Select the requested outcome and supported option; provide missing information or a purpose-specific decision.
Present choices and client actions; show the current permitted per-function result through the Global API.
Own setup and recovery coordination. This recorded direction does not establish a separate onboarding service.
Supply qualified identity, authority, protected access and connection evidence. Keep their decisions separate.
Qualify activation, preserve invoice origins and apply runtime checks for their own operations.
Execute only the selected qualified contract and provide operation evidence.
Own assigned unresolved work and evidence-backed manual action; assignment alone does not prove success.

ac:layout-cell.p: The existing decision record retains owners and gates. These open decisions affect scope or delivery.

ac:layout-cell.p: Verify the business and actor, assess existing setup, and run the required public/private checks. Missing approval enters ONB-12; portfolio processing uses ONB-13. Uncertain effects enter ONB-08 and return to the affected check.

Solid arrows show work or a result. Dashed arrows show selected or conditional work. The columns identify paths, not service boundaries. A combined setup can use several branches. Recovery and approval remain conditional activities, not alternative delivery routes.

ac:layout-cell.p: SEI019 defines these activities. Approval and recovery can interrupt a check; independent client work can continue.
Spain identity, representation and provider rules remain country-specific. Reusable journey patterns need the selected country and provider evidence.

Reuse the existing FR APIs with Spain country-pack tailoring. Public readiness and private-provider setup need different qualifications. Keep business mapping, traffic changes and unresolved dependencies visible; engineering detail stays in SEI021.

Existing Tax Service certificate capability is the intended reuse source; exact Spain fitness remains to qualify. DTS is the preferred transformation candidate for later invoice operations under SPEC-SEI-008. Onboarding itself establishes neither implementation as ready.

tr.td: Authority or trust evidence is missing
Hold dependent work and return the eligible action owner.
An external change has an unknown outcome
Preserve the original operation and check actual state before repetition.
Routing decides hold or continuation from evidence, even before local activation.
Earlier invoices still need the previous path
Retain required access until the historical-continuity gate passes.
Capacity and service targets are unqualified
Set measurable limits and objectives from approved contracts and pilot evidence.

ac:layout-cell.p: One high-level logical journey covers ONB-01–13 and OFR-01–08. Public/private setup, approval and portfolio work are activity groups; delivery-feature boundaries remain for Product and Engineering to agree.
Certificate, connectivity/routing and invoice-operation features retain their existing responsibilities. SEI019 links their handoffs.
Before enabling a scope, confirm scenario/actor coverage, qualified business authority and access, safe recovery, historical continuity and an owner for each open gate.
SEI019 holds the functional acceptance checks; SEI021 holds engineering qualification. Neither establishes production readiness.
